notes.author: ted
notes.text: Bri helped at the community serve day with a group from her dorm. She worked the whole shift sorting school supplies and asked good questions about what the church does the rest of the year.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Bri asked online to join Pastor Pete's group. Let her know it meets in the Fosters' home in the evening. {@pete} will reach out before her first visit.
notes.testPurpose: A follow-up with a mention and a reply from the mentioned staff member.

replies.author: pete
replies.text: Thanks. I'll call her this week and offer her a ride if she needs one.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Bri wants to bring two friends from her dorm to Young Adults Night. {@alisha}, please add three to the pizza order and set out name tags for them.
notes.testPurpose: A second unread mention of Alisha Marble (decision 308). Bri is on Ted Decker's Young Adults Night tag.
